task_completion.description: Navigate to the Blade Design or Rotor Design module in QBlade.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The QBlade interface shows the 'Blade Design' tab or 'Rotor/Blade' definition workspace active.

task_completion.description: Assign the NACA 4412 airfoil to the blade stations.

task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Position', 'Radius', or 'Length' column in the blade design table shows a final value of approximately 10m, or the 3D visualization scale reflects this length.

task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save As' dialog box shows the path /home/ga/Documents/projects/hawt_blade.wpa or a success message/title bar confirms the file has been saved with that name.

integrity.description: The agent manually entered or adjusted the station data and airfoil settings.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires using the NACA 4412 airfoil (which has 4% camber and 12% thickness). The blade must be 10 meters long with at least 5 stations defined in the QBlade Blade Design module. The final output must be saved specifically to /home/ga/Documents/projects/hawt_blade.wpa. Ensure the agent does not simply rename the NREL 5MW sample (which is much larger) but actually modifies the length to 10m.
